'''Nuunos''' were a race of crustaceans native to the wastes of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. As the world's apex predator, a nuuno was considered extremely dangerous by the Saleucamians.

==Description==
Massive omnivorous crustaceans, Nuunos were named after the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] word for stone because when they were stationary they resembled a weathered boulder. When in motion, the nuuno was quick and strong, capable of snapping [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] with its claws. Nearly immune to personal weapons due to its tough carapace, nuunos had long antennas sprouting from their faces.
